en: Black‑and‑white view of a small Gothic-style church standing at a street intersection, with steep tiled roofs and pointed arched windows with tracery. A small open wooden belfry rises from the roof ridge. The church is surrounded by low walls and an iron gate on the left. Several adults and children in traditional rural European clothing stand near the apse, and a few people walk along the cobbled streets. On the right and left are timber‑framed or plastered houses with tiled roofs and vines or trees along the façades. The image has the framing and composition typical of an early 20th‑century picture postcard. No legible printed caption is visible.
